description: Show one memory's full version history plus the memories most related to it. Each entry has a version number, a timestamp, a size and a preview, so you can see how the work changed without downloading every revision. Pass a version number to pastepile_restore to bring one back. Name the memory by `session` if you still know the session name you saved under, which you usually do, or by `slug` if you have it. Give exactly one. With an API key this reads that key's full server-side history; without one it reads this device's trial-memory timeline.

session.description: The session name you passed to pastepile_remember. Prefer this: it is the identifier you can reproduce after a long conversation, and the slug is not.

slug.description: The memory slug (e.g. "abc123") or its full Pastepile URL, as returned by pastepile_remember or pastepile_recall.

name: pastepile_timeline
